context.purpose: Turn bounded numeric tables, or typed labelled tables of text IDs, notes and measurements that may be missing, into editable, recalculated ODS and XLSX workbooks with checked summary formulas and a CSV handoff. Optional named cell bounds and weighted reconciliation enforce declared numeric performance in both native formats.
context.assumptions: Exactly one table. Numeric tables have 2 to 10000 finite numeric rows; typed tables declare every column as text or number with explicit nullability, 1 to 10000 records, at most 100000 cells and a reserved null token. CSV paths are absolute. Native LibreOffice runs headlessly with an isolated user profile. A producer may publish the CSV as a table or a generic file artifact; file does not imply the content is valid.
context.constraints: No arbitrary spreadsheet formulas, hyperlinks, macros, styles or general workbook editing; text beginning with =, +, - or @ stays literal. Typed tables infer no types, dates, currency, time zones or units, reject empty text and booleans, and summarise only declared number columns. Column units are authored labels; no automatic unit conversion. Floating-point tolerances are explicit; published workbook numbers keep 15 significant digits.
context.inspection: Inspect data.csv through table/series views (the typed CSV also quotes text and uses the null token) and reopen the native workbooks. Independent host checks validate every cell type, text value, blank, formula and recalculated cache in both formats; typed-summary.json records counts, missingness and exact-value digests.
context.recovery: INVALID_TABLE requires rectangular finite data with valid column names; CSV cells must be plain ASCII decimals (no 1_000, currency, percent or blanks) and the fault locates the record and column. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND requires a configured soffice. Preserve conversion logs and retry a corrected input in a fresh run. REQUIREMENTS_UNMET retains numeric assessments and workbooks; REQUIREMENT_SELECTION_FAILED identifies missing/text cells. Inspect observed margins and retry corrected input in a fresh attempt. For typed tables, INVALID_TABLE locates rows[i][j] (or columns[j].name for a header difference) with the column, offending value and a recovery hint: use strings for text, numbers for number columns, null or the null token for missing values, and never empty text. RESOURCE_LIMIT reports a bound. A tampered or stale typed-summary.json, data.csv or captured CSV reports VERIFICATION_FAILED. Binding a file artifact whose bytes are not the declared CSV (binary, empty label, renamed header, padded number) is INVALID_TABLE before any native work; an unaccepted artifact kind is TYPE_MISMATCH and a missing index is INVALID_SELECTION.

completion.scope: Typed labelled tables added to the existing schemaxis.calc/1 route as one capability: fromTypedRows and readTypedCSV (declared text/number columns, explicit nulls, reserved null token), typed Summary with MISSING, typed data.csv handoff and typed-summary.json evidence, plus the numeric route's Summary-width/blank selection handling. lifecycle.timeout: Each native process is bounded by the runner timeout; conformance adds an independent wall-clock watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation retains partial evidence. Pre-launch cancellation is tested separately from shared in-flight cleanup.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh run directory retains authored input, effective plan, native submissions/stdout/stderr, publications and verification evidence.
lifecycle.verification: Independently parse ODS/XLSX data, formulas and cached summaries and compare the CSV round trip and publication hashes. Recompute each declared requirement from both native formats; reject altered, linked, malformed or oversized assessment evidence. Typed tables are additionally read back cell by cell from native XLSX and reopened ODS (string/number/blank type, exact text, absence of formulas outside the fixed Summary set, links, rich text, styles, macros and external references), and typed-summary.json and data.csv are regenerated from the retained input and compared.
